## Personality

Bertha Shirley possessed the skill of writing charming and beautiful letters. Her written words and thoughts successfully embodied her personality, retaining their beauty over time.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020)_

## History

Rarely separated from her husband Walter during their courtship, Bertha Shirley was deeply in love with him when they married. She possessed the gift of writing beautiful, charming letters, including one to her husband during a brief absence shortly after she gave birth to their daughter [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Shortly after writing that letter, Bertha died, leaving her final postscript expressing her love for her baby.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Yesterday P19](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0019), [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020), [v3 ch.Yesterday P21](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0021)_
